title: GPT-4 and a host biomarker combine to diagnose lower respiratory tract infection
summary: A classifier combining tracheal aspirate FABP4 expression with GPT-4 analysis of electronic medical record text reached AUC 0.93 and 84% accuracy in a derivation cohort, versus 72% for the primary team's admission diagnosis, and AUC 0.98 and 96% accuracy in an independent cohort of 115 adults. The reference standard was retrospective multi-physician adjudication and cohorts are small. Preprint of 2024-08-29.
ai_technology: GPT-4 large language model assessment of electronic medical record text combined with FABP4 transcriptomic biomarker

evidence.tested: Independent validation cohort of 115 adults with acute respiratory failure (AUC 0.98).
evidence.unknown: Prospective utility, cohort generalizability and peer-reviewed status are not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: GPT-4 assessed record text to give diagnostic information combined with a biomarker.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; author affiliations were not available. Publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
